items.name: Morcant's Gate-Ember
items.lore: Won from Morcant of the Gate when The Gate Stirs was ended. A coal of blue fire, quenched and cold.

items.name: Lord of Misrule's Antler Crown
items.lore: Won from the Lord of Misrule when The Fool's Revel was ended. A circlet of antler and blue beads.

items.name: Scathach's River Torc
items.lore: Won from Captain Scathach when Siabra on the River was ended.

items.name: Mother Pikebane's Claw
items.lore: Won from Mother Pikebane when The Fishing Bears' Bad Year was ended.
